title.en: The relational self and 大同

summary.en: The folder holds a self as what a knot of relations is doing, a false split of individual and collective, and 大同 as a direction reachable by mechanism. The self's form went into 07 §4 and 08, there made conditional and the crux left open; the word 大同, the five constants and the 人类命运共同体 formalism are absent from the live account. Divergence is prominent: no law evaluates, relation gives no cooperation, language has no attractor toward 理.

name.en: The I as an action-centre of gathered relations

source.locator: The theory in one paragraph; claim 1

sense.en: A self is no bounded thing that later enters relationships: it is what a knot of relations does at a place, formed by body and nature, care, language, others' recognition, institutions and history, and its own choices and corrections. Stated as observation of causal order, from a book drafted from Ren's ideas.

entries.quote: 「我」非关系之外之原点，乃诸关系暂聚而成之行动中心

reading.en: Same form: a center is a formation and its own region a closure along some relation, so 'self' is relative to a relation drawn within the unfolding. The explanatory form is an argued thesis, not proved. The account does not list what constitutes a person, and any formation is a center, so center is wider than the source's agent. [AI reading]

says.en: On the thesis of one relational unfolding, argued and not proved, positions, regions and standards form within it. A center is a formation; its own region is its closure under some relation.

Thesis, argued: forbids an explanation needing a determination no relation carries, such as a self with a nature of its own. Configurations, laws and parts as represented need nothing more; that the theory as a whole needs no independent entity is argued, and neither shows reality has none.
Reading [AI reading]: along a relation a formation's boundary is given by a region holding it and closed under the relation; which boundaries it has depends on the relation followed.

account_adds.en: What the represented dynamics leave open is which relation or class is a center's own; a privileged narrower relation is costly, not refuted.

source_adds.en: The inventory of what forms a person (care, language, recognition, institutions) and the self's own choices and corrections as part of the knot.

name.en: Relational constitution increases autonomy

sense.en: Seeing how one was formed lets one tell which desires come from life and which were installed, and which beliefs one examined. So relation raises autonomy rather than lowering it: an isolated self has only wilfulness, a self in relations can be free.

entries.quote: 孤立之我只有任性，关系中之我方有自由

reading.en: Nearest, and not this claim: 07 §1 separates a standard's influence, recognition, warrant and being followed, says learning a disposition is not learning a reason, and reads that later endorsement cannot authorize the formation that produced it. No law or reading says that seeing one's formation raises freedom. [AI reading]

source_adds.en: The whole mechanism, autonomy through seeing one's own formation.

name.en: Self-care and other-care as one instruction

sense.en: Caring for oneself and for one's environment was one common sense; individualism against collectivism is the wreckage of it, and both halves split are pathological. The inner logic of relational thinking: the better the world, the better I am. Stated flatly, Ren's own.

entries.quote: 这个世界越好，我也就越好

reading.en: The account gives where the unconditional form holds. Narrow and wide concern are one presupposition with the boundary at narrow or wide scope, and they coincide exactly where every center lies in every center's closure. Clearing witnesses the other case: a part retaining everything for the clearer loses the dweller. So 'one instruction' is a condition on the net, whether met being empirical. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any type; World instances). Route (b) and the condition are one presupposition, 'however the boundary is drawn' at narrow and at wide scope; along the empty relation sub-truth is a standpoint's own good, along the total relation the condition.
Theorem (any type; World). Held de se, self-concern is the same from every standpoint exactly where every center lies within every center's closure; the whole need not lie within it.

Theorem (World) and Conditional (the condition). With each formation's significance stopping at its dependence, the clearer's part retains everything for the clearer and loses the dweller for the dweller.
Thesis: a collective is a region of formed relations, not a unit with an interest of its own; conflict and difference stay real.

account_adds.en: A self-concerned order can reverse where the other course keeps an independent copy (`Weighting.some_increasingInOwn_reverses`); the two come apart in named cases.

source_adds.en: The historical claim of an original common sense and its wreckage, and the label 'collectivism' as an outside oversimplification.

name.en: Therapeutic individualism and disciplined faculties

sense.en: Therapeutic individualism is past selfishness: it does not weigh others and choose itself, it has lost them from the frame, so a relational wound is treated as repairable by inner work. Separately, relation-aware faculties incompatible with the system get disciplined, producing misalignment suffering; atomisation domesticates and harms both self and network.

entries.quote: A wound produced by relational rupture is treated as repairable by internal work alone.

reading.en: Both are diagnoses of a culture and a psychology; the account makes neither. Its blindness law says what lies beyond a coupling closure is unselected, a formal neighbour of 'dropped out of the frame' with no reference to any culture, therapy or suffering. A shared form with that law is no carrying of the diagnosis. [AI reading]

source_adds.en: Stands only here and in its sources in 12-claude-ai-chats.

name.en: Individual solutions to a collective problem

sense.en: Offering individual solutions to a collective problem reproduces the disease diagnosed, a standing correction Ren applies to his own drafts. In the 2026-10-04 monologue: one may seek peace and love, but structural problems must be solved first; one cannot simply drop out. A value stance.

entries.quote: Offering individual solutions to a collective problem reproduces the disease being diagnosed

reading.en: Same form under hypotheses: where the others alone outrun a renewal, a member's act changes no score reading the condition from then on; each staying within a step's giving does not keep the joint take within it. The law bears on one kind of case and evaluates nothing, and a restraint within the joint slack can keep a need. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (World: balance, activity needing support, only active giving). Where the rest jointly take more than a step gives across n steps from below n + m, dependents end whatever a member outside the rest takes; no weight on such a reading selects the member's restraint. Depletion need not be the only equilibrium.
Theorem (World: balance). Formations can each take within what a step gives while together they take more.

account_adds.en: Named collective exits, each under hypotheses, none shown of an actual collective: pooling couplings, restraint within joint slack, exclusive footprints, reading the loss in time.

source_adds.en: Urgency, and the claim that the individual framing itself reproduces the disease.

name.en: Interconnectedness, not compassion, requires cooperation

source.locator: Claim 6; The argument, 'Why does cooperation follow?'

sense.en: Cooperation must follow from structure, not feeling: outcomes are coupled, some problems are soluble only by the whole, and rivalry cannot cure what it creates. Compassion is an evolved module, a good North Star, unreliable in practice: it narrows to the tribe, serves violence, is operable by power.

entries.quote: So compassion is the bearing; interconnectedness is the argument.

reading.en: The structure is there: joint excess and differences parts make only together. 'Requires cooperation' is not: mutual dependence is not mutual benefit, and among optimizers restraint is no mutual best response. A structural reason for cooperating needs an order, so C or a premise in its place. The blindness of sympathy has a reading in 06 (见牛未见羊). [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (World). Mutual dependence: every continuation can be affected, at some remove, by every other. The section: mutual dependence is not mutual benefit.

Theorem (any process). Parts make a difference together while no member alone does exactly where they make it together and withholding any one leaves the move breaking the dependence; such a difference needs at least two parts.
Law (World; a mutual best response, its existence not shown in general): each takes its whole capacity wherever something stands beyond, so restraint is no mutual best response.
Reading [AI reading]: 见牛未见羊, selection is blind beyond couplings, one's own act included.

account_adds.en: Which orders select restraint and which do not, and that an evolutionary explanation of a disposition is not its warrant, recognition or following (04, Development).

source_adds.en: Compassion as a bearing with its catalogue of failures. 06 only says care has several entries to be tested side by side.

name.en: Relation does not generate ethics: the parasite

sense.en: Interdependence is a lens, not a foundation. It makes ethical commitment legible and shows why atomistic frameworks fail, but it does not generate ethics; what we owe each other is chosen. An AI review's correction the corpus adopted, leaving one owned is-to-ought step.

entries.quote: a parasite is related to its host

reading.en: The same limit, now by construction of the representation: no statement reading only the dynamics entails the continuation condition, none reading no order entails C. The source's one owned step became two premises with two roles, the condition for scope and C for order, neither asserted, warrant open. Non-entailment by the represented dynamics, not a proof about becoming. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any type). Where there is a standpoint and a formation, a statement reading only the dynamics that entails the condition holds of no dynamics. It shows non-entailment by the represented dynamics, not that becoming leaves significance undetermined.
Two premises, neither asserted: the condition fixes whose losses count and ranks nothing; C gives order. A statement reading no order entails C only where it fails (`ReadsNoOrder.not_entails`).

account_adds.en: The folder asks which downstream claims survive the demotion; the account gives laws with no premise, then what each premise adds. It does not call the premises chosen: warrant stays open, and P1 reads part of scope as what acting presupposes.

name.en: Maintaining the self is a step to the whole

sense.en: Two evolutionary axes, maintaining the self and orienting to everything beyond. Satisfying the first steps into the second: every recognised self is the whole recognising that self; the environment is created by every self in it, so in a way they are also the self; beyond the drive there is no self. Ren's own, 2026-04-19.

entries.quote: the environment is also created by every self within it, therefore, in a way, they are also the self

reading.en: The structural neighbour is the widest row of §4.7, the self drawn as everything one conditions, and P4. The source asserts what the account leaves as its crux: under P1 to P4 concern reaches everything downstream of one's acts, and P4 is not shown. Objections: the wrong bearer, losses are not effects, redefining the word. The condition (scope) and C (order) stay premises either way. [AI reading]

says.en: Argument [AI reading; each step cites its Lean, the joining argued]: under P1 to P4, one's concern for one's own continuation reaches everything downstream of what one conditions, with no step of invariance. P2 and P4 are the crux.

AI reading, argued, not proved: all one's effects has no reason beyond the arguments given; none of the candidates is ruled out, and P4 is not shown. It concerns whose losses count, not what one answers for.

account_adds.en: What the path does not reach: each center counting beyond its part as a condition, and whatever no chain joins. Those remain the step's.

source_adds.en: Two axes as evolved drives, and satisfying the self (not in survival mode, not hijacked) as a precondition for coherence with the whole.

name.en: Good as what is good for self and network

sense.en: Good is what is good for both the self and the network it is in; better is the direction of increasing both; where they conflict, use wisdom, never either/or, never disregarding the future. Stated as Ren's value criterion.

entries.quote: use wisdom, never either or, never disregarding the future

reading.en: The source calls it good; the account gives the comparison with no premise and calls it better only under C, the condition fixing scope, neither asserted. The form matches: a part's own widening widens the whole exactly within others' margins, and otherwise is mixed. 'Use wisdom' corresponds to what the account leaves to further named premises, J1 to J4. Better reads admission, as compared by a weighting. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (World; balance). Where a part's activity widens what can form within its own region, the whole widens exactly when its net draw stays within the margin for every formation outside the region; mixed exactly when beyond for one. Mixed is not ordered.

Theorem (finite listing, two-valued admission, natural weights). One course widens another exactly when every positive weighting ranks it higher; a mixed comparison is decided both ways. Calling it better is C.
Choices take more, following from neither the condition nor C: a reading of living, the lifting L and the commitments J1 to J4.

account_adds.en: An exact local test, and the refusal to rank where a part's gain costs another.

source_adds.en: An unconditional definition of good, and wisdom as the arbiter at conflicts.

name.en: Boundaries and ego as territorial instinct

sense.en: The Western concept of boundaries is territorial instinct in connotation-neutral words, extending past space into social interaction and possession; ego is the same drive generalised from what is mine to what reality should be. Offered tentatively as a psychology ('Not sure if this is how the brain evolved').

entries.quote: instead of where and what is mine, it becomes this what reality should

reading.en: Same word, no same reference: the account's boundary is a region drawn along a relation, in one sense for anything, with no instinct and no ego. 04 asks of any disposition what mechanism produces it, and that a benefit not be taken as origin, which this conjecture has not met. The folder itself lists it as lost from later drafts. [AI reading]

source_adds.en: Stands only here and in `drives-narrative-attractors-and-mind`, by the folder's own Relations.

name.en: 大同 as direction, not destination

sense.en: 礼运's verb is walking, so 大同 names a bearing, not a place; a pole star used to find direction and never reached. The question is never when we arrive but whether today's act moves toward or away. A direction cannot be achieved and defended, so it cannot become a totalising attractor. The 古文 essay is AI-composed to Ren's one-line prompt.

entries.quote: 今日所行，向之乎？背之乎？

reading.en: The direction-not-state form is the account's, under another name: 生生, compared by widening, under the condition (scope) and C (order), both unasserted. The test 'toward or away' answers only widenings; hard cases are mixed and get no verdict. The word 大同 is absent from the live account; the one spine reading, 大同 and 小康 as two boundary drawings, stands in history/CHINESE-SOURCES-AND-BECOMING.md. [AI reading]

says.en: The direction is a criterion on which every positive weighting agrees, not a quantity to maximize, and it says nothing where the comparison is mixed. Available 'as a criterion only'.

Thesis T8, argued, no verdict binding every possible mind: for life, the way is 生生, compared by widening, counted for everything (scope: the condition) and ranked by what every valuer who counts everything shares (order: C).

Theorem (any process; witnesses), as stated at COLLECTIVE-DIRECTION §7: where every step from some step on is a move of a process Q, the possible under Q does not keep widening. Read [AI reading] openness is of how rules keep changing, not a rule chosen once.

account_adds.en: Where no widening move exists: past a point of no return, after a window closes, where the rest outruns the renewal.

source_adds.en: 大同's own content, the grammatical argument from 行, and the pole star as a practical orientation.

name.en: 大同 as a maintained attractor basin

sense.en: 大同 is a continuously maintained dynamic condition, a generative attractor basin, in English a civilisation's capacity to return to the Great Way after drift; a society can drift out and return. Not a historical endpoint. From the AI-drafted book.

entries.quote: a civilisation's *capacity to return to the Great Way after drift*

reading.en: The account has basins and returning, without a good one among them: attraction is not returning, stability and a frozen rule are one structure read from two sides, and points of no return are exact. A basin of one fixed law cannot keep the possible under it widening, so an attractor is not the direction's form. No law names a generative basin. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any type). Under any determined law, courses meeting is an equivalence whose classes are basins; a course reaches every returning configuration of its basin.

Reading [AI reading, D49]: 稳与元闭 are one structure on the spine, read from the side the rule holds as stability and from the side of a change as a frozen source; judgment enters only through comparison, never through a definition.

Theorem (any process): where every step from some step on is a move of Q, the possible under Q does not keep widening; keeping it widening needs the held part to change without end, which does not suffice.

account_adds.en: Exact laws of return, and that keeping a course open is not more options: a configuration can be reached at every step and never return.

source_adds.en: A named good basin and capacity to return as what 大同 is.

name.en: 大同 is not uniformity: 和 not 同

sense.en: Harmony is difference in a relation where parts check and complete each other; sameness ends generation. Formally in the SSBX layer: 大同 affirms universal middle and is neutral on uniformity, winner-take-all requires uniformity, so reading 大同 as 整齐划一 is refutable. Content: 万物并育而不相害, a thousand paths in parallel.

entries.quote: 和实生物，同则不继

reading.en: Same structure with a narrower object. A pool adds exactly its differences; an imposed code makes all agree and each loses the distinctions it merges; 并育不相害 has the form of a part's draw staying within others' margins. These are laws of selection, codes and draws, evaluating nothing. 和而不同 itself is an evaluation of conduct. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (World). A group's closure is the union of its members'; with members listed and coupling decided, a pooled selection separates two histories exactly when some member does not couple them alike.
Reading [AI reading, D54]: 和而不同, with members listed and couplings decided, what a pool adds is exactly the difference; pooling the same adds nothing.
Theorem (any type). An imposed code makes all agree; each formation loses exactly the distinctions its code drew that the imposed code merges, the source of the imposed code losing none.

account_adds.en: What exactly is lost and to whom, and that a merged distinction returns only from a form held outside, or by coining.

source_adds.en: The SSBX theorem on 大同 and winner-take-all, not on the spine, and 同则不继 as a law of generation: no law says sameness ends generation.

name.en: 礼运's indicators as coordination problems; production sufficient

sense.en: 老有所终 and the other three are not a perfect state but coordination problems of the form 'the resource exists and the distribution mechanism fails', each now with a technical programme. Production now suffices for everyone's basic needs, so the bottleneck moved from production to coordination. Marked conditional.

entries.quote: the resource exists and the distribution mechanism fails

reading.en: An empirical claim about the world and a reading of one text; the account makes neither. Nearest in form: whether any flow is possible is whether active members can together give each step's demand (`Flow.possible_iff_covers`), and division by exclusive footprints keeps a level. Neither says what actual production suffices for. COLLECTIVE-DIRECTION keeps positional goods zero-sum and conserved stocks rivalrous. [AI reading]

source_adds.en: The whole claim. It stands in the folder's sources, 大道之行 and the 2026-04-11 chat.

name.en: Environment selects struggle or cooperation

sense.en: Humans carry a struggle and a cooperation repertoire; environment rather than disposition decides which expresses, so sufficiency plus safety moves a society toward 大同 by default. Ren first says the modes are in the genes and accepts that what is coded is the switch, not the setting. Neuroscience supplied in conversation.

entries.quote: 足够富足，能过上好日子，就会自然走向大同的方向

reading.en: Parts have form. Same carrier need not fix response, on one witness. A formation sparing what it waits on restores giving; without one, withholding stays. But the default fails for orders: rising orders take their whole capacity wherever something stands, however much, and only a set point stands at enough. What decides is the order's form, not abundance. Whether humans have such a switch is not stated. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (periphery, pre-spine module; witness). In a finite model two histories with the same carrier, differing in developmental order, form different connections; the same carrier and operations do not fix the same response function.
Theorem (any type). Restoring needs a formation that spares all it waits on, which gives from step 1 whatever the start; without one, total withholding stays.
Law (World; a mutual best response, existence not shown in general): each takes its whole capacity wherever something stands.
Theorem. Where an eligible outcome reaches the set point every optimum stands at it, whatever the room; below it, every optimum takes the part's whole capacity beyond.

account_adds.en: That a set-point order still draws its shortfall and can break a dependence beyond it.

source_adds.en: The empirical claim about human repertoires, and the default direction under sufficiency. The folder itself marks this as not following from the ontology.

name.en: 大同 as a memory; agriculture removed the ceilings

sense.en: 大同 may be a memory: in abundant environments small mobile groups lived so by default, demand-sharing and the freedom to walk away capping accumulation. Agriculture removed those ceilings, not the disposition, so recovery is architectural, not moral. A historical conjecture, Ren's own, with Sahlins supplied in conversation.

entries.quote: Agriculture removed the ceilings, not the disposition.

reading.en: A historical conjecture with no counterpart. The history dossier, not live, says of the 礼运 passage that the text's telling of 大同 as a way once practised is narrative, not derivation. Taken as architecture, the recovery half goes to the next entry; the history stays here. [AI reading]

source_adds.en: The whole historical claim; the row p-ru-liyun-da-tong-xiao-kang in history/CHINESE-SOURCES-AND-BECOMING.md addresses only the text's own telling.

name.en: Recovery by rebuilding removed negative feedbacks

source.locator: The theory in one paragraph; Register one

sense.en: 大同 is reachable by mechanism, not conversion: material sufficiency plus restored negative feedback (real exit, ceilings on accumulation, cheap verifiable trust, coordination not routed through a capturable centre) moves the default toward cooperation.

entries.quote: rebuild the removed negative feedbacks at scale

reading.en: The account's exits have this shape: carrying what acts do back into what selects the rule, reading beyond the share, pooling. It states them narrower and without promise: no guarantee, each exit under hypotheses, none shown of an actual collective, several with a closing window. 'Reachable by mechanism' becomes achievable under stated conditions. [AI reading]

says.en: Exits from the loops that lock a collective, each with its law, hypotheses and edge; 'Achievable under stated conditions: yes, for named exits, none shown to hold of an actual collective'. Always guaranteed: no.
Reading [AI reading, D48]: term limits, audits, courts and antitrust carry what an actor's acts do back into what selects the rule: pooling, not opposed interests.

Theorem (any type). A reading favouring at no loss above a bound unlocks the course after every reading step past it, a sufficient way out; where the reading too is formed monotonically from the share, a change of any size is absorbed.

account_adds.en: The edge of each exit, and that where the reading is formed from the share a new reading is absorbed.

source_adds.en: Real exit and ceilings on accumulation as named mechanisms: not modelled. The folder also notes it has no account of what leaving costs a constituted self.

name.en: The target is the topology of feedback on drives

sense.en: Ren's self-correction: environment is not the whole story. Unchecked positive feedback on drives (status, dominance, acquisition, hatred) breaks a system regardless of abundance, so the target is the topology of the feedback the drive runs in, not the drive and not the environment alone.

entries.quote: drive如果可以channel到一个和谐幸福的方向，而不是corruption

reading.en: Same form on models: a loop closes a difference only through a link giving back less; draws exceeding all earlier draws need a stock of at least 2^n - 1, so abundance only buys steps; 'more than now' and 'above all others' have no rest. Stated of conditions and targets, not of human drives; how targets form is not modelled. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any type). Where every link gives on at least what it receives the difference never falls, so a loop closes a difference only through a link giving back less.
Theorem (World: balance, nothing given). Where each step's draw exceeds everything drawn since T, what stood at T is at least 2^n - 1. How fast an actual draw grows is not shown.

Theorem. 'More than now' is met only by change, and at every step needs an open world; 'above all others' is met by at most one seeker, so no unchanged state meets it for two. How a target forms is not modelled.

account_adds.en: Exact conditions for closing, keeping or exceeding every bound.

source_adds.en: Status, dominance and hatred as the drives concerned, and channelling a drive toward happiness rather than removing it.

name.en: Shared symbols selected toward one root

sense.en: In a communication environment of 和, symbols shared across frameworks are selected toward a monist attractor, concepts traceable to a common root. So 大同 is no utopia but the direction in which language and existence automatically manifest, toward 理, good and 生生不息. Flagged by Ren as hypothesis, both premises.

entries.quote: 乃是一个语言与存在自动向理，向善，向生生不息的方向manifest

reading.en: The account takes up shared codes and says otherwise. Agreement comes from one origin or a broken symmetry; the forms that can become shared are the forms in use; nothing in these laws tests a form for reaching 理 or good, and imposing a code agrees as well. No automatic direction toward good exists in the account: no dynamic is good, and 理 there means lumping. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any type). Where two forms differ, an order brings every start to agreement exactly where it gives all formations one origin; the forms that can become shared are exactly the forms in use. How long agreement takes is not stated.
Theorem (any type). Imposing one code makes all agree in a step and keeps every exchange of formations: agreement from symmetry without a formation above the others, by privileging forms.
Theorem (any type). Majority adoption makes no form; two holding different forms both rest, so agreement needs a broken symmetry.
Reading [AI reading, D54]: writing as a reading system is strongly relational, but the graph itself encodes no relational ontology.

account_adds.en: What an agreed code costs, and that free-energy minimization breaks no symmetry.

source_adds.en: An attractor of communicating intelligences, and the joining of existence to language. The folder also says it is joined to register one by nothing yet.

name.en: Cooperation has to reason; struggle only has to win

sense.en: Once there is contention, 'I am right' and the I becomes greater than 理: cooperation must give reasons, struggle need only prevail. Ren's correction of his own premise, from an egalitarian environment to an environment of 和 rather than 争.

entries.quote: 合作才讲理，斗则讲赢

reading.en: A proposed structural form, only of the second half: a rule read from the share it selects reads nothing beyond it, so it outlives a growing loss. That is 'only has to win' where winners write the reading. No law says cooperation brings reason, and T7's trained judge turned on notes read by a minority. Thin: the mechanism is capture, not contention as such. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any type). Where neither the next share nor the rule read reads the beyond, courses alike in share and rule stay alike; from a locked configuration the loss passes every bound while the course stays locked.

Thesis T7: a metric whose rule and reading are formed from the share it selects is kept by its selectors however large a loss it does not read grows, and is dropped only through a change in what the loop reads. In the model only invariance and the lock are proved.

account_adds.en: What turns such a course, and that T7's frozen tests fell partly against one case.

source_adds.en: That an environment of 和 makes parties reason at all.

name.en: Evolving toward struggle is selected against

sense.en: Struggle-optimised traits (his example: males over-optimising appearance) go extinct when the environment changes, because they are not 生 and adapt poorly; accumulating toward the future, the 生 that is recognised, is 理. Marked conditional, Ren's own.

entries.quote: 当境变化的时候，这些就更可能会灭，因为它非生，适应性低

reading.en: Position does not protect a part depending on what the race draws down: it ends with the rest. But in the clearing witness a greatest part not depending on it continues, so struggle is not selected against in general. That race produces joint excess is a premise. Selection in the account favours by its rule, with no tie to 生. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any type for counting; World for the race). A part requiring a condition past the joint excess is not active: position does not enter. In the clearing witness a greatest part not depending on what it draws down continues. That a race produces joint excess is a premise.

account_adds.en: The condition under which a position-winner ends and the witness where it does not.

source_adds.en: Selection across environmental change, low adaptability of struggle traits, and accumulation toward the future as 理.

name.en: 一元 as return to one root, and plural

sense.en: 一元 is not cardinality but all concepts returning to one root. Many traditions do this and differ in which root: god, emptiness, struggle, extinction. 一生万物 is itself pluralism: monism at the root and plurality in the world are one claim.

entries.quote: 我说的一元当然不是基数，是所有概念回归同一root

reading.en: The account's grammar has this shape: one kind of symbol, a relation read as condition, with sameness always relative to a plural class. It says nothing about which root is right, and its thesis of one unfolding is argued and has no strength by its own measure. Same form, and no claim that traditions share or lack this root. [AI reading]

says.en: The chapter takes one relation, read as condition, and one class, read as sameness, and shows what their meet, continuation, carries.
Definition: a class is a reflexive, symmetric, transitive relation. Reading [AI reading, D69]: the class is plural; the grammar names the class and says everything relative to it.
Reading [AI reading, D54]: the theory never identifies 道 with any spine term; 无, 一, 二, 三 do not by comparison become the empty set, a bit or an operation.

account_adds.en: The relation's root is stated as a model's choice, with 'what would defeat it' named.

source_adds.en: The comparative claim about what different religions return to.

name.en: Scale self-similarity: we are the collective

sense.en: We are in the system and are the system, so the 理 between us and the cells in our bodies is the same at that level. We may be individual but cannot disregard the collective, because we are it; all should behave as if part of the whole. Hence 人类命运共同体. Ren's own.

entries.quote: 我们可以"个人"，但不能不管集体，因为我们即是集

reading.en: The account refuses this form where it would matter: a shared process implies no cosmic subject and no aggregate interest, a collective is no unit with an interest, and part-whole is three relations, with no fixed ladder of scales. From 'we are the system' no 'should' follows, and a ranking needs C, the condition fixing scope. [AI reading]

says.en: Nonduality erases no difference in experience, history, access, control, consent or consequence. A shared process implies no cosmic subject, no aggregate interest and no administrator entitled to speak for everything.
Thesis: a collective is a region of formed relations, not a unit with an interest of its own; conflict and difference stay real.
Reading [AI reading, D65], Part and whole: inclusion, functional participation and dependence are distinct relations; cell, organ, body, ecosystem is one biological case, not a fixed ladder.

account_adds.en: That a law across scales needs its own relation, and that an intervention on a whole needs an admissible realization.

source_adds.en: One 理 across scales, and behaving as part of the whole as what follows.

name.en: One civilisation, one global system

sense.en: There is one civilisation and one global system, societies its subsystems, and the us-against-others stance ('I'm the biggest ... those shall be mine') has to go. Spoken, from an automatic transcript, Ren provisionally Speaker B.

entries.quote: We only have one global system that we are subsystems of that system.

reading.en: The factual half is the account's, as a reading of what is empirical: human beings plausibly lie in one another's feeding closures. The account adds that this scope reaches nothing after the step it is read up to. 'Has to go' is not said: rivalry stays, positional goods stay zero-sum, and an order needs C. [AI reading]

says.en: Reading [AI reading, D64]: through one atmosphere, biosphere and economy, human beings plausibly lie within one another's feeding closures; if so, every human being's self-concern, held de se and drawn along what carries it, has one scope there. Whether they do is empirical.

Starting from relations removes the frame of a fixed sum divided among independent owners. It does not remove rivalry, and both are theorems. Reading: positional goods stay zero-sum, conserved stocks rivalrous.

account_adds.en: What 'one system' can and cannot give self-concern, read with time.

source_adds.en: The value stance against us-versus-others, and cultures' common teaching of limits on desire (claim 45).

name.en: 修齐治平 as capacity-responsibility matching

sense.en: 修身齐家治国平天下 is not sequence but whether I have the capacity and standing to act: an ordering by causal radius, responsibility lying where capacity reaches. Bounded: blaming the powerless yields only self-reproach; pleading weakness to refuse feasible good is evasion. Weight in deciding grows with capacity.

entries.quote: 力之所及，责之所在

reading.en: Bounded responsibility is here, by named sources, as a commitment beyond the condition (scope) and C (order). The account parts reach from responsibility: capability is reach, widening the gap to coupling, and whose losses count is not what one answers for. Its 大学 reading keeps the necessary direction as a condition chain, where the source denies order, and refuses the sufficient one. [AI reading]

says.en: Argument, reviewed and scoped. Responsibilities arise from named sources, each limited; an empty plan set generates no duty, a contribution is indispensable only where every admissible allocation requires it. Bounded responsibility is among J1 to J4, further premises (as COLLECTIVE-DIRECTION §4 lists them).
Reading [AI reading, D45]: capability is reach, and the gap is the reach closure less the coupling closure, so capability extending reach without extending the coupling enlarges the gap.
Reading [AI reading, D54]: 大学 '其本乱而末治者否矣', the necessary side holds; '身修而后家齐', the sufficient side does not generally hold.

account_adds.en: The separation of reach, whose losses count, and answerability, and the reason (RP) an answerable actor has for repair.

source_adds.en: Responsibility scaling with causal radius as such, and evasion by pleading weakness.

name.en: 王道 and 天子: the largest owes most

sense.en: The scaling rule for power inverts the usual one: those of largest causal radius owe most. Even the largest is 天子, whose being should make the relations of 天下 harmonious and prosperous. The folder keeps it as a ledger the largest is judged by, not a guardian to be trusted, an obligation and not a mechanism.

entries.quote: 王道者，非权利之最大化，责任之最大化也

reading.en: No statement that responsibility rises with power, and 'maximisation of responsibility' sits badly with responsibilities from named sources, each limited. The source's own rule of checks in proportion to reach has a neighbour in the reading of term limits and courts, but that reads coupling, not owing. See the entry on the ledger of meaning. [AI reading]

source_adds.en: The whole claim, with 天子 as its name. Note the folder's critique: without those governed holding the ledger, it is the better-guardian answer.

searched: live account; 06 traditional and simplified forms

name.en: A ledger of meaning changes what consolidated power is rewarded for

sense.en: Where meaning rests on moving history in a better direction rather than on dominance, the reward system changes when power is consolidated. So a civilisation's ledger of meaning decides which self-model selection favours at the top: the 大同 mechanism stated as selection. Spoken, conditional.

entries.quote: A civilisation's ledger of meaning decides what consolidated power is rewarded for

reading.en: Read a ledger as what the rule reads. Then it holds where the reading is not formed from the share: a reading favouring at no loss above a bound unlocks, and if formed monotonically from the share any change is absorbed. So a ledger kept by those it rewards changes nothing; the others must read it, in time. Selection sign depends on what comes back to shapers alone. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any type). A reading favouring at no loss above a bound unlocks the course; where the reading too is formed monotonically from the share, a change of the reading of any size is absorbed at the next reading step.
Theorem (counts). At a step the rule favours the shapers exactly where c ≤ s, whatever p comes to every member alike.

Theorem (counts). The others read a loss once it reaches a bound; at a reading step where the loss has reached it and the rule in force favours the shapers, the course is locked in their favour for good from the next step exactly under the stated condition. COLLECTIVE-DIRECTION §2: once the late reading would favour the shapers, every later reading keeps the lock.

account_adds.en: Why a good narrative alone does not turn the lock, and the window for reading. All on two-kind count models, without noise.

source_adds.en: Meaning as what sets reward, and the civilisational scale.

name.en: 仁义礼智信 as one layered structure

sense.en: The five are layers of cooperative existence, fractal not sequential: 仁 the relational root (人+二), 义 fittingness asking at whose cost, 礼 transmissible form, 智 situational discernment, 信 temporal consistency at the centre. Each degrades when cut from 仁. Inherited structure; Ren's the question. They also answer a relational agent's practical questions.

entries.quote: 仁以成我，义以安位，礼以共行，智以辨向，信以守真

reading.en: Only one piece: 06 notes 郑玄's reading of 仁者人也 as 相人偶 among the relational roots, and reads 德 as a formed, revisable capacity to respond, whose ethical sense goes through comparison. The layering, the five as a set and their degradations are absent. The folder notes they serve as description, prescription and scaffold at once. [AI reading]

says.en: Reading [AI reading, D54]: every line has a relational root, among them 郑玄 reading 仁者人也 as the 人 of 相人偶.
Reading [AI reading, D54]: 德 read as a formed, still revisable capacity of response; reliable execution can reliably harm, so its ethical sense passes through comparison.

account_adds.en: That no virtue's goodness is given by its reliability.

source_adds.en: The five as one layered structure, 信 as time and centre, and each one's characteristic degradation.

name.en: 大道废，有仁义: named virtues as scaffolding

sense.en: Read constructively: civilisation compresses the Great Way into named virtues once it stops being visible in shared life. They can repair a civilisation and cannot replace the Way, and degenerate if cut from it. This explains why moral vocabulary proliferates as moral reality thins. From the AI-drafted book.

entries.quote: 支架者，大道之局部压缩，可以修补文明，不可代大道

reading.en: The passage has no row in the live account, nor in the history dossier by either written form. Its form would need a 'Way' prior to named norms, which sits near what 06 records as non-relational layers, so taking it up would need care. Nearest: a rule read from the share outlives what it was for. [AI reading]

source_adds.en: The whole reading.

name.en: The convergence across traditions names one object

sense.en: Confucian, Ubuntu, Buddhist, Indigenous, cybernetic and ecological traditions converge on one object, which Ren names the structure of cooperative existence for finite beings; 'today we are so mad we lost it collectively'.

entries.quote: the structure of cooperative existence for finite beings

reading.en: For the Chinese lines checked, the account says less and otherwise: a relational root in every line, its universal form often needing scope, and as a property of each system false, with four non-relational layers recurring and each answered within its tradition. It names no convergent object, and shared form is not shared meaning. Other traditions are not compared there. [AI reading]

says.en: Assessment; the classes and readings are AI's [AI reading, D54]: relational ontology is a leading thread in these traditions and a position within each; it is not a property of every system nor the consensus of the commentaries. Scope slightly exceeds agreement, 98 to 91.

account_adds.en: Counted relations by passage, and the non-relational layers: a prior ground, a preset nature or value, a will or single ruler, contention and rank.

source_adds.en: The naming of the object, and Ubuntu, Indigenous and cybernetic traditions in the comparison.

name.en: A community needing no shared definition of the good

sense.en: 人类命运共同体 requires no transfer of sovereignty, only mutual trust and consensus, at every scale, and no shared definition of the good future: cultures differ, and helping one another beats contending to be king. Its core is 家国天下, and it must absorb markets and technology. Ren's value stance.

entries.quote: 真正的命运共同体不需要主权让渡，需要的是彼此信任共识

reading.en: One clause has a form: differing valuers need no common utility, since every positive weighting shares widening. Exactly this much: they share no verdict on mixed cases, the hard ones, and valuing positively is C's premise relocated, with the condition for scope. 'Better than contending' is unranked if contending is mixed. Sovereignty and consensus are not taken up. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem. The order shared by standpoints whose orders increase in admission is exactly widening, and calling it better is C. A mixed comparison is decided both ways. Monotonicity at the standpoint is C's premise relocated.
Thesis: joint activity is explained from actual relations, not opposed interests, bargaining or a fixed common utility.

account_adds.en: The exact limit of agreement among differing valuers, and evidence (T5) with frozen rules passed and failed.

source_adds.en: No sovereignty transfer, trust and consensus as sufficient, 家国天下, and markets and technology to be absorbed.

name.en: 共开 ∧ 共续 ∧ ¬夺共续, a checked characterisation

sense.en: 人类命运共同体 is three independent Boolean axes, with an iff over eight states and three counterexamples: 245 lines of Lean, 0 sorry, 0 new axioms, in the SSBX development. 命, 运, 体 are re-expressed from existing roots, not admitted as primitives. Its own report: not a political manifesto formalised. The folder warns it proves less than its placement suggests.

entries.quote: three independent axes, all three or nothing

reading.en: The formalism is not on the spine, and the account says why two of its terms are not mapped: openness indexed to a focus hands openness to owners, against starting from one relational unfolding, and 夺 is stated through such openness; capture carries that content instead. The discipline against importing primitives survives as method. [AI reading]

says.en: Mechanism: two early items are not mapped, openness indexed by a focus, which allots openness to owners against the method, and 夺, stated through each focus's openness; as capture of a selection it is at target capture.
Theorem (any type). Where target carriers each leave at least a offspring and others at most b < a, the carriers' offspring stand to the others' strictly more than the carriers to the others.

account_adds.en: Comparison instead of definition: whether a closing supports or damages 生生 comes through comparison, with the condition for scope and C for order, both unasserted.

source_adds.en: The community's three-axis model, kept outside the account; `Renlei` has no hit in the live text.

name.en: Dualism as root of the totalising dynamic

sense.en: The metaphysical root of the totalising dynamic is the subject-object split and treating 'the subject wants good for itself' as definitionally rational, a tradition-specific commitment mistaking itself for universal. The folder also records the objection that selection would act on relational cognition too. Ren's value stance.

entries.quote: wrong ontology plus the machinery that let it compound

reading.en: The account says starting from relations removes one frame and not rivalry. Its capture and drain laws hold of any type and any selection, so they need no dualism, and 06 finds a relational method with a contending direction in 兵家 and 法家. Distinctions must state their basis, a demand on explaining, not a cause of harm. [AI reading]

says.en: Starting from relations removes the frame of a fixed sum divided among independent owners. It does not remove rivalry, and both are theorems.
AI classification: 兵家 and 法家 have the highest share of divergence, 8 of 13; the method is relational, the direction contending.
Subject and object, actor and patient, fact and value are each drawn within the unfolding, along relations, together with what they leave out.

account_adds.en: Mechanism without a metaphysical cause: what selects, what couples in, what the rule reads.

source_adds.en: A causal claim from ontology to the dynamic, and the historical critique of rational self-interest.

name.en: Institutional codification as the totalising step

sense.en: Dualism is necessary but not sufficient: dualistic medieval Christendom did not generate Moloch at scale, partly non-dualistic dynastic China extracted at scale, and the totalising step is codification: property and inheritance, money as universal equivalent, corporate personhood. AI pushback adopted.

entries.quote: the totalising step is the *institutional codification* of dualism's implications

reading.en: Not taken up: the spine sets up no relation of possession, and no money or personhood, and 05 models one kind of institution, an entry rule on a stock, saying it is no definition. Its rule locks and captures are the formal neighbours of codification, with no historical claim attached. [AI reading]

source_adds.en: The historical comparison and the named institutions.

name.en: Asymmetric scrutiny of non-Western vocabulary

sense.en: Western political vocabulary travels as unmarked universal while non-Western terms are flagged 'from culture X': a standing reading error, first caught on 命运共同体. The folder adds that it cuts both ways: a culture label on a dynamic is its mirror image, and 大同 carries state associations for outside readers.

entries.quote: if a flag is warranted for one it is warranted for the other, or for neither

reading.en: Not stated as a rule in the live account. Practice shows nearby: 06 records a tradition's divergence by passage, and 08 keeps names structural. The instruction to label a field's frame as that field's stands in the repository's working instructions, not the account. [AI reading]

source_adds.en: The rule, stated for reading political vocabulary.

read: 08 'Criteria' on names: its first line only

name.en: AI must not be used for struggle

sense.en: The root position of the 智善 organisation: AI must not be used for struggle; intelligence belongs to all humanity, for building 大同世界 and everyone's welfare. Stated flatly as a stance.

entries.quote: 人工智能不能被用于斗争，智能用于所有人类

reading.en: The account's direction for AI is conditional on the continuation condition (scope), C read as widening (order), J1 to J4 and correspondence E, all unasserted, and alignment first asks what a selection reaches. It forbids no use by itself, and the source's flat root position is what it gives only under premises. [AI reading]

says.en: Conditional: align AI formation, learning, action and revision with actual living and further generation within the whole, governing trade-offs through real losses, basic living conditions, bounded responsibility and legitimate participation.

account_adds.en: What holds with no premise: what a selection reaches, and that several optimizers drain by their joint capacity.

source_adds.en: An explicit refusal of contest uses, and intelligence as belonging to all.

name.en: 大同 as ontological implication; alignment isomorphic to it

sense.en: Alignment and 大同 are isomorphic at three levels: floor, not oriented toward the bad; middle, the field within [平, 和]; upper, flourishing across AI, humans and ecosphere. And 大同 is the ontological implication of 間: actors with interwoven worldlines in a shared 間 are already in a community of destiny.

entries.quote: 「大同」不是间的远期愿景，「大同」是间的本体论 implication

reading.en: Ontology implies no such thing in the account: being joined gives mutual dependence, which is not mutual benefit, and no law or premise entails a community from a net. 間 as a primitive has been replaced by the grammar of the root. Alignment is first what a selection reaches, with a direction only under premises. No isomorphism is stated. [AI reading]

says.en: Section heading text: read the closures of the map as the whole; mutual dependence is not mutual benefit.
Reading [AI reading, D54]: the early scheme of 文言 as formal language, with an original 間, has been replaced by the grammar of the root, and its claim of completeness was not proved.
What a selection reaches: alignment with no premise; a direction follows only under the premises of §7.

account_adds.en: A condition on the net for each sense of being joined, and why any ought is added apart.

source_adds.en: The three-level isomorphism and the spacetime reading of 命运.

name.en: The bounded self as the disease: cancer logic

sense.en: The disease is a self-model: a you caring only for what you perceive as you, modelling 'even more', pursued without seeing what you and your world are; compounding, this is cancer logic. Humans can develop such an alienated, cancerous or evil ego, a capacity and no fixed nature. Selection, molochlization, rewards it. Spoken; automatic transcript.

entries.quote: there is a you that you only you cares about what you perceive as you

reading.en: Mechanism carried, evaluation and interior not. A selection reaches only what couples in; omitting a required condition, a draw can lose its own support. 'Even more' has no rest. But the position is not a defect, how a center represents its region is unmodelled, and no law says a loss is a harm. So acts and couplings, not a judged ego. This answers the folder's 反诛心 worry by not asking. [AI reading]

says.en: Thesis T3: a selection through couplings reaches only what couples into its selector, and with room its optima drain what lies beyond as far as any eligible outcome does. The law for optima is proved; the clause on trained systems is conjectured, partly supported.

Theorem (World). Omitting a required condition, its own draw can lose its own support; over a region covering what it requires it keeps its own and can still undermine another. How a center represents the region is unmodelled.
Reading [AI reading, D26]: the position is not a defect; 无明 is the seeking it leaves locked.

account_adds.en: A narrower self-model can keep its own support and still undermine another, so own loss does not decide the case.

source_adds.en: The ego as cognitive structure, greed and anger as the moments it takes over, and the word disease.

name.en: Deciding from relations, not from a target

sense.en: A relational decision begins from present relations, constraints and what can be done, not from optimising a target around one value. A target-first decision draws a boundary round what it counts; where winning compounds, selection favours it, while a relations-first decider bears the costs. The joining is the assistant's reading, citing a formal proposition in a paper.

entries.quote: 而不是围绕某一个价值，去优化一个既定的目标

reading.en: The target-first half matches T3's law, and an act beyond one's closure is selected by no member. The relations-first half is not a law: the account has no decision procedure of this kind, and two formations, a model and an order, can act alike where no selection tells them apart. An objective is a selector and an order, not a scope. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (World). An act whose difference stays beyond the actor's coupling closure is selected alike by every selection through the coupling of any member of the closure, the actor among them.
Theorem (any types; a witness). Two blanketed laws related so that values sensed and acts are one give the same values and acts at every step, so no selection through those tells the two apart.
AI reading: an objective is a selector and an order, not a scope; read as a correspondence not shown, an optimizer's objective resembles the intended self.

account_adds.en: The folder's own point sharpened: a frame alone changes no selection.

source_adds.en: The procedure itself, its starting questions, and that relational reasoning's costs lose under compounding.

name.en: Ordinary competition is not the disease: the wolf

sense.en: Asked if all competition is bad, Ren narrows the target to a cognitive structure. The wolf's existence is not just about the wolf, and it does not eat to get bigger: ecological competition is part of an ecosystem. Spoken; automatic transcript.

entries.quote: the existence of the wolf is not just about the wolf

reading.en: The account draws no line here by interior. Predation, apoptosis and ending a cancer are all mixed, and telling harm from non-harm needs a measure, which it has not got. 'Malignant' and 'winning' focal formations are ranked alike by the whole-run reading under C. The line it does draw is renewal: a dependence that returns or never returns. [AI reading]

says.en: Under the condition every narrowing loses something with significance. Predation, apoptosis and ending a cancer, read as losing and opening something, are mixed [AI reading, D65]; telling harm from non-harm among them needs a measure.

Conditional (C; World). Read whole-run, the course without an overdrawing formation extends the course with it, so every comparison satisfying C ranks it higher, for a malignant and a winning focal formation alike; read event by event the two are incomparable.

account_adds.en: That the ranking turns on the reading, whole-run or event by event, and on C.

source_adds.en: A difference in kind between the wolf and the ego, by what the eating is for.

name.en: 心 and 理 as one dynamic in the person

sense.en: Feeling and reason are not opposed: they form one dynamic, 心理, in which 理 keeps 心's positive feedback from running away. The good side is innate and has to be shaped. A constructive reading of the compound, from a monologue quoted through a translation; supplied by Ren as his own, not confirmed by ear.

entries.quote: 感受和理性也不是二分的

reading.en: The account has no interior of a person. Its nearest terms are not this one: 理 in 03 is lumping and 06 warns of same-word senses; regulation changes a condition through a response; 06's 王阳明 reads 心即理 as a responding side within relation, not an ontology of mind. 'Innate good' falls under what 06 logs as divergence (先定的性或价值). [AI reading]

source_adds.en: It stands in this folder and `drives-narrative-attractors-and-mind`, by the folder's own Relations.

name.en: 逍遥: no independent self when the model fits

source.locator: Claim 53; own words 64-66; What fit is like

sense.en: When one's model fits reality one is nearer 逍遥; self and environment are one, there is no independent self, only forces in motion. The folder's epistemic reading, marked the assistant's: the separate self belongs to a model drawing a boundary the world does not have. Quoted through a translation.

entries.quote: 因此，也就没有一个独立的“自我”。

reading.en: The account denies a self with a nature of its own, and yet keeps boundaries: one short of the whole is real, relative to its relation, and nonduality erases no difference. So a fitted model does not lose its boundary; which relation is one's own stays the de se question. Fit has a neighbour in losing one's own support by omitting a requirement. 逍遥 is absent. [AI reading]

says.en: Reading [AI reading, D45, D61]: a boundary short of the whole is real, since its relation never crosses it, and relative to that relation.
Nonduality erases no difference in experience, history, access, control, consent or consequence.
Theorem (World). Omitting a required condition, its own draw can lose its own support. How a center represents the region is unmodelled.

account_adds.en: The several closures, nested or pointing opposite ways, each drawing a boundary of its own.

source_adds.en: What fit is like from inside, and 逍遥 as the name of it.

name.en: 己所不欲 from knowing others' minds resemble one's own

sense.en: The golden rule follows from knowing that one's own 心理 resembles others': a route through theory of mind, beside a route in 生生不息论 through what returns via the system. From the translated monologue.

entries.quote: 你也知道，自己的心理与其他人的心理很相似

reading.en: A spine reading exists only in the history dossier: 恕 selects through a model lumping the other with oneself, so it is right exactly where the other's likes vary as one's own, and blind to difference elsewhere. So the source's premise is the rule's scope, not its proof. Live 03 states the law of selection through a map without the verse. [AI reading]

source_adds.en: Stands at history/CHINESE-SOURCES-AND-BECOMING.md, rows p-ru-lunyu-shu and p-lunyu-shu-ji-suo-bu-yu, the first citing `Learning.selects_right_through`; a theory-of-mind derivation is not stated there.

name.en: The tradition's two engineerings, and needing to win

source.locator: Claim 56; The tradition's two tracks; critiques

sense.en: The tradition holds a social engineering for relations (儒) and, for struggle, 法家 and 《孙子兵法》, grounded in theory of mind, knowing conflict escalates and so not pursuing extremes; in the present order 'we really do need to win'. The folder records this against Ren's own self-critique of 外儒内法.

entries.quote: 在这个过程中，我们确实需要赢

reading.en: The account keeps the relational method and registers the direction as divergence: reading a situation relationally, pointed at one standpoint's advantage. It adds that two seekers of 'above all others' cannot rest together, so the refusal of extremes has a law's form. 'Need to win' is not said: rise needs fall, and no order is read from that. [AI reading]

says.en: AI classification: 兵家 and 法家 have the highest share of divergence, 8 of 13: 势 is configuration and 参 a joint use of channels, the method relational, the direction contending.
Reading [AI reading, D54]: one victory cuts and does not stop the loop; 犹有晋在 is two seekers of 'above all' unable to rest together. Its frame is power's, recorded as divergence.

account_adds.en: Which parts of those texts match laws, passage by passage.

source_adds.en: The two tracks as complementary competences, and the judgement about the present order.

name.en: 人类命运共同体 accepted on its merits; official formulas continue the kernel

sense.en: The narrative is accepted regardless of sponsor's motive and articulated apart from state framing. Later: official formulas (人类命运共同体, AI 向善) continue the 大同 kernel, policy runs 小康 to 大同. Marked contested; the folder proposes one standard for all polities and notes the official sequence is Ren's reading.

entries.quote: 我认可这个叙事本身，不论隐藏动机，它是我们现在需要的一条出路

reading.en: The account makes no judgement of any polity's narrative and names no state. The folder's own ruling, that theory texts argue about the dynamic and not about a pair of states, is what the account does. 06 holds a source text as evidence of a word's sense, a quotation being no ground of a claim. [AI reading]

source_adds.en: The whole. Held as open in the folder and `OPEN-QUESTIONS.md`, not in the account.

name.en: Shaping a people's expectations as most legitimate

sense.en: Shaping a society's expectations, language and political expression, which the West calls propaganda, carries values leading a people as a whole and has the most legitimacy and historical height. Recorded by the folder as a value stance in tension with claim 30, not a result, with legitimacy proposed to come from contestability instead.

entries.quote: 这类东西才最具有正当性（legitimacy）和历史高度。

reading.en: The account's pieces run against the claim and with the folder's answer: later endorsement does not authorize the formation that produced it; endorsement does not erase a loss; readers drawn from what a rule selects lock it. Its direction asks for effective chances to challenge and revise. It speaks of formation generally and judges no polity. [AI reading]

says.en: Reading [AI reading, D65]: later endorsement cannot authorize the formation that produced it.
Conditional (the condition, C read as widening, J1 to J4, correspondence E): legitimate participation, with effective opportunities to understand, challenge and revise.

Theorem (counts). The rule after shaping read as the pool of its readers' readings: it reads the share monotonically exactly where lo ≤ hi, and against it where hi ≤ lo. The premise of the loop is moved to who reads, not removed.

account_adds.en: Mechanism for why shaped endorsement certifies little.

source_adds.en: The stance itself, kept as Ren's in the folder. Whether contestability is the account's standard of legitimacy is not stated in those words.

name.en: The struggle comes with scale, not with a people

source.locator: Claim 62; What is generic, and what is his

sense.en: The struggle is neither the West's nature nor humanity's; the possibility arises once very large societies with many dynamic processes exist. Offered by the monologue as its own correction of its East-West framing; the folder follows it and argues about the dynamic.

entries.quote: 这种斗争并不是西方的本色，更不是人类的本色。

reading.en: The laws of race and position hold of any drawers with no culture in them, which is the form of the correction: among two or more, a best response for position keeps nothing. They do not show actual races are so played. The tie to the size of a society is not stated; loops and pace are. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem. Among two drawers or more a best response for position keeps nothing. With one drawer every profile is perfect. It does not show that actual races are so played, or that drawing everything is wrong.

account_adds.en: That with one drawer the race law has no force: number enters, size as such does not.

source_adds.en: Scale as the historical cause.

name.en: Characters record inter-tribal convergence

sense.en: Chinese characters record inter-tribal communication through symbols that converged on agreed denotations, evolving as memes; 止戈为武 is an example. Marked conjecture; the folder itself says the etymology is contested, and that the example should not be offered as evidence. Conjecture 2 of the SSBX README is related.

entries.quote: The conjecture stays tiered as conjecture, and the etymology should not be offered as evidence for it.

reading.en: The folder's caution is the account's reading. 武 graph-history and the 左传 line are two layers, parts do not fix a reading, and the graph encodes no relational ontology. A code formed between formations is proved of hearings, with no claim about Chinese history. The historical conjecture is not taken up. [AI reading]

says.en: Reading [AI reading, D54]: 止 is a foot, 武 holding a halberd and walking; 止戈为武 is 楚庄王's value interpretation. The theory does not say 武 originally means stopping halberds.
Reading [AI reading, D54]: most characters are phonetic compounds; the graph itself encodes no relational ontology.

account_adds.en: Four kinds of correspondence for characters, and acceptance levels.

source_adds.en: The history of negotiating tribes.

name.en: Cultural observations: horizons, power, engineering

sense.en: Observations: Chinese futures begin from the children and American ones from the self; relational thinking does not habitually meet power with hostility; Chinese engineering skill comes from relational thinking. The folder marks the last as unsourced with rival explanations, and in tension with listing pragmatism among the kernel's degenerations.

entries.quote: 这也是为什么中国人很擅长工程这样的问题

reading.en: Claims about cultures, untaken and out of the account's form, which argues about dynamics. On power it has a structural neighbour only: checks that carry acts back into what selects the rule. It says nothing of attitude. [AI reading]

source_adds.en: The whole; kept as Ren's observations in the folder.
